title: Applying the Loss Kernel geometric probe to a small safety-relevant classifier

original_idea.body: Applying the Loss Kernel geometric probe (arXiv:2509.26537) to detect a toy backdoor/anomalous mode in a small classifier; report anomaly-detection AUROC. Maps to ARC anomalous-behavior open problem.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Backdoor/anomaly detection maps to an ARC open problem but the probe's catastrophic-risk chain has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny classifier with inserted backdoor + described probe method; guided execution feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused AUROC deliverable; reimplementing the Loss Kernel probe adds some effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Anomaly-detection tooling on open models, weak lab incentive, independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Tiny classifier and inference-time probe; near CPU/single-GPU scale.

novelty.reasoning: Novel application of a recent probe to backdoor detection; angle plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probe exists; backdoor-detection application may be open.
